propositions: Three separate verifier code paths (review_kernel/verify.py, completion.py, workflow gates) independently resolve the verifier model using equality checks against a default constant, causing non-default models to silently suppress the standard class downgrade.

When a non-default provider is configured for the standard class, verifier paths resolve to models from a different provider than intended, splitting brain between configured class slots and actual model selection.
code-review.yaml's verify step declares no model key and carries temperature:0 for determinism, but the setting takes no effect when the step resolves to the frontier model on the Anthropic adapter.

A single reserved-word resolver (resolve_model_string) must exist to disambiguate class names (trivial/standard/frontier) from literal model ids across multiple call sites, with lazy function-level imports required to avoid circular dependencies between model_classes.py and config.py.

The resolution funnel config.resolve_model must call resolve_model_string to make class declarations in YAML (model: standard) work, and this call site is shared as a prerequisite with the ladder escalation path (7761).
